No.A.12034/1/2022-MPSC (DR)
MIZORAM PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
Mizoram New Capital Complex, Khatla
Dated Aizawl, the 7th August, 2026.
NOTIFICATION
Subject: Mizo Language Proficiency Test-2 of 2026-2027
Mizoram Public Service Commission Notification No. A.12034/1/2022-
MPSC(DR) Dt.13/06/2024-in a tarlan angin Mizo Language Proficiency (Qualifying Test) chu
proof of Mizo Language Proficiency nei lote tan neih tur a ni a.
Mizoram Public Service Commission hnuaia hna diltu, Proof of Mizo Language
Proficiency nei lote tan MPSC Online Portal https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in/ ah
Application Form fill up theih a ni ang.
Mizo Language Proficiency Qualifying Test hi Dt. 07.09.2026-ah neih tur a ni.
MLP (Qualifying Test) Syllabus chu Mizoram Public Service Commission official website
https://tinyurl.com/MLP-Syllabus ah en theih a ni.
Last Date of Application : 27/08/2026 (Thursday)
Admit Card Download : 28/08/2026 – 07/09/2026
Date of Examination : 07.09.2026 (Monday)
Sd/-JAMES LALRINCHHANA
Controller of Examinations
Mizoram Public Service Commission
Memo No. A.12034/1/2022–MPSC(DR) : Dated Aizawl, the 7th August, 2026
Copy to :
1. Sr.PPS to Chairman, Mizoram Public Service Commission, for information.
2. PA to Member, Mizoram Public Service Commission, for information.
3. PS to Addl. Secretary, Mizoram Public Service Commission.
4. PA to Controller of Examinations, Mizoram Public Service Commission.
5. All Officers, Mizoram Public Service Commission for information.
6. Office Order Book.
(VANLALTANPUIA)
Joint Controller of Examinations
